question: P. Q and R are partners and invest in a business. P invests 1/5th of total investments and Q invests 1/4th of the total investments. What is the ratio of investments of P, Q and R respectively?
solution:
Given:

P invests 1/5th of total investments

Q invests 1/4th of the total investments

**Calculation:**

Taking L.C.M = 5, 4

LCM = 20

Let the total investment be Rs. 20.

P invests 1/5th of total investments** **= 20/5 = Rs. 4

Q invests 1/4th of the total investments = 20/4 = Rs. 5

Thus R invests = Rs 20 - (Rs. 4 + Rs. 5)

⇒ 20 - 9

⇒ Rs. 11

Thus ratio of the profit of P, Q and R respectively is 4 : 5 : 11.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
